name: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: A classic Roman pasta dish with eggs, cheese, pancetta, and black pepper.

steps.title: Boil the pasta water
steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add a generous amount of salt — it should taste like the sea. This is the only chance to season the pasta itself.

steps.title: Make the egg and cheese mixture
steps.instruction: In a bowl, whisk together the 2 eggs, 1 egg yolk, most of the Pecorino and Parmesan, and a generous amount of black pepper. Set aside.

steps.title: Cook the pancetta
steps.instruction: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the pancetta until crispy and the fat has rendered, about 5-7 minutes. If using garlic, add it now and cook 1 minute more. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.instruction: Cook the spaghetti in the boiling salted water until al dente, about 1-2 minutes less than the package says. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Combine off heat
steps.instruction: Add the hot drained pasta to the skillet with pancetta. Remove from heat entirely. Quickly pour in the egg mixture, tossing rapidly. Add pasta water a splash at a time to create a silky, creamy sauce. Work fast — the residual heat cooks the eggs without scrambling them.

steps.title: Serve immediately
steps.instruction: Plate the pasta, top with remaining cheese and more black pepper. Serve right away while hot and creamy.
